text: 你好，我有嚴重食物敏感。
back_translation: Hello, I have a serious food allergy / food sensitivity.

text: 落單之前，請你細心睇清楚呢張卡。
back_translation: Before ordering, please read this card carefully and clearly.

text: 我對以下食物敏感：
back_translation: I am allergic / sensitive to the following foods:

text: 我嘅敏感好嚴重，就算食咗好少份量都可能會病得好嚴重。
back_translation: My allergy is very serious; even if I eat a very small amount, I may become very seriously ill.

text: 呢種敏感可以危及生命。
back_translation: This kind of allergy can endanger life.

text: 我對某啲食物不耐受。唔會危及生命，但會令我好唔舒服。
back_translation: I am intolerant to certain foods. It is not life-threatening, but it makes me very uncomfortable.

text: 呢個係醫療問題，唔係個人喜好。
back_translation: This is a medical problem, not a personal preference.

text: 多謝你小心處理我嘅食物。
back_translation: Thank you for handling my food carefully.

text: 花生
back_translation: Peanut

text: 所有果仁，例如杏仁（扁桃仁）、合桃、腰果同榛子
back_translation: All nuts, such as almonds (badam / sweet almond), walnuts, cashews and hazelnuts

text: 杏仁（扁桃仁）
back_translation: Almond / apricot kernel (flat peach kernel, i.e. sweet almond)

text: 榛子
back_translation: Hazelnut

text: 合桃（核桃）
back_translation: Walnut (walnut)

text: 腰果
back_translation: Cashew

text: 碧根果
back_translation: Pecan

text: 巴西果
back_translation: Brazil nut

text: 開心果
back_translation: Pistachio

text: 夏威夷果仁
back_translation: Macadamia nut (literally 'Hawaii nut')

text: 牛奶同所有奶類製品
back_translation: Cow's milk and all milk / dairy products

text: 蛋
back_translation: Egg

text: 魚
back_translation: Fish

text: 甲殼類海鮮，例如蝦、大蝦、蟹同龍蝦
back_translation: Crustacean seafood, for example shrimp, prawns, crab and lobster

text: 貝殼及軟體類海鮮，例如青口、蜆、蠔、魷魚同八爪魚
back_translation: Shellfish and mollusc seafood, for example mussels, clams, oysters, squid and octopus

text: 黃豆（大豆）
back_translation: Soybean (soybean)

text: 麩質（小麥、大麥、黑麥，同埋未經認證無麩質嘅燕麥）
back_translation: Gluten (wheat, barley, rye, and oats not certified gluten-free)

text: 小麥
back_translation: Wheat

text: 芝麻
back_translation: Sesame

text: 芥末（芥菜籽同用佢整嘅嘢，例如黃芥末醬、芥末粉、芥末油）
back_translation: Mustard (mustard seed and things made from it, such as yellow mustard sauce, mustard powder, mustard oil)

text: 西芹（包括根芹同芹菜鹽）
back_translation: Celery (Western celery) (including celeriac and celery salt)

text: 羽扇豆粉同羽扇豆籽
back_translation: Lupin flour and lupin seeds

text: 亞硫酸鹽
back_translation: Sulphites

text: 松子
back_translation: Pine nuts

text: 椰子
back_translation: Coconut

text: 蕎麥
back_translation: Buckwheat

text: 粟米
back_translation: Corn / maize

text: 豆類，例如小扁豆、鷹嘴豆同青豆
back_translation: Legumes, such as lentils, chickpeas and green peas

text: 奇異果
back_translation: Kiwi fruit

text: 紅肉，同埋用哺乳類動物製成嘅明膠（α-gal 敏感）
back_translation: Red meat, and gelatin made from mammals (alpha-gal allergy)

text: 桃，同埋其他有核水果，例如李、杏同車厘子
back_translation: Peach, and other stone fruits, for example plum, apricot and cherry

text: 蘋果
back_translation: Apple

text: 香蕉
back_translation: Banana

text: 芒果
back_translation: Mango

text: 番茄
back_translation: Tomato

text: 蒜頭
back_translation: Garlic (bulb)

text: 洋蔥，包括蔥同乾蔥
back_translation: Onion, including spring onion / scallion and shallot

text: 雞肉，包括雞湯同雞粉
back_translation: Chicken meat, including chicken soup / stock and chicken powder

text: 豬肉，包括豬油同豬骨湯
back_translation: Pork, including lard and pork-bone soup / stock

text: 明膠（魚膠粉），無論用豬、牛定係魚整
back_translation: Gelatin (gelatin powder), whether made from pork, beef or fish

text: 味精
back_translation: MSG (monosodium glutamate)

text: 包括用佢整成嘅任何油、醬汁、醬料、粉、黃油或者裝飾配料。
back_translation: Including any oil, sauce, condiment / paste, powder / flour, butter, or decorative garnish made from it.

text: 請檢查有冇用花生油，包括炸嘢用嘅油。
back_translation: Please check whether peanut oil is used, including the oil used for frying things.

text: 請檢查醬汁，例如沙嗲醬、青醬、墨西哥摩爾醬同果仁糖。
back_translation: Please check sauces, for example satay sauce, pesto (literally 'green sauce'), Mexican mole sauce and praline / nut candy.

text: 請檢查甜品有冇杏仁膏、牛軋糖或者杏仁粉（扁桃仁粉）。
back_translation: Please check whether desserts contain almond paste, nougat or almond flour (badam flour).

text: 請檢查有冇魚露或者鯷魚，包括沙律醬。
back_translation: Please check whether there is fish sauce or anchovy, including in salad dressing.

text: 請檢查有冇蠔油或者XO醬。
back_translation: Please check whether there is oyster sauce or XO sauce.

text: 請檢查有冇蝦醬、蝦膏或者蝦米。
back_translation: Please check whether there is shrimp sauce, shrimp paste or dried shrimp.

text: 請檢查有冇魚湯底（例如日式木魚湯或者木魚碎）。
back_translation: Please check whether there is fish stock base (for example Japanese bonito stock or bonito flakes).

text: 請檢查有冇豉油，豉油入面都有小麥。
back_translation: Please check whether there is soy sauce; soy sauce also contains wheat.

text: 請檢查有冇麵豉、豆腐或者豆醬。
back_translation: Please check whether there is miso (bean paste), tofu or bean paste.

text: 請檢查有冇海鮮醬、豆豉或者其他豆醬。
back_translation: Please check whether there is hoisin sauce (literally 'seafood sauce'), fermented black beans or other bean pastes.

text: 請檢查有冇麻油、芝麻醬，或者面頭灑咗芝麻。
back_translation: Please check whether there is sesame oil, sesame paste, or sesame sprinkled on top.

text: 請檢查煮嘅時候有冇用牛油、印度酥油、忌廉或者芝士。
back_translation: Please check whether butter, Indian ghee, cream or cheese is used when cooking.

text: 請檢查有冇奶粉、乳清或者酪蛋白。
back_translation: Please check whether there is milk powder, whey or casein.

text: 請檢查麵包或者酥皮有冇掃蛋液，同埋炸漿有冇蛋。
back_translation: Please check whether bread or pastry is brushed with egg wash, and whether the frying batter has egg.

text: 請檢查有冇蛋黃醬或者蒜蓉蛋黃醬。
back_translation: Please check whether there is mayonnaise or garlic mayonnaise (aioli).

text: 請檢查有冇用麵粉打芡或者上粉。
back_translation: Please check whether flour is used to thicken (sauce) or to coat / dust.

text: 請檢查湯底、湯包同調味粉。
back_translation: Please check soup bases, soup packets and seasoning powder.

text: 請檢查有冇喼汁，喼汁入面有鯷魚。
back_translation: Please check whether there is Worcestershire sauce; Worcestershire sauce contains anchovy.

text: 請檢查有冇酒、醋或者乾果（含亞硫酸鹽）。
back_translation: Please check whether there is wine / alcohol, vinegar or dried fruit (contains sulphites).

text: 就算係共用器具沾到嘅少少份量，都可能會引起敏感反應。
back_translation: Even a small amount picked up from shared utensils can cause an allergic reaction.

text: 請唔好用炸過我敏感食物嘅油或者炸爐。
back_translation: Please do not use oil or a fryer that has fried my allergen foods.

text: 請用乾淨嘅鑊、煎鍋同餐具。
back_translation: Please use a clean wok, frying pan and utensils.

text: 請用乾淨嘅砧板同刀。
back_translation: Please use a clean chopping board and knife.

text: 請唔好用共用嘅燒烤爐或者鐵板煮我嘅食物。
back_translation: Please do not use a shared grill / barbecue or griddle plate to cook my food.

text: 整我嘅食物之前，請洗手同換過手套。
back_translation: Before making my food, please wash hands and change gloves.

text: 請唔好加任何我未確認過嘅裝飾、配料或者醬汁。
back_translation: Please do not add any garnish, toppings / ingredients or sauce that I have not confirmed.

text: 請分開整同分開上我嘅菜。
back_translation: Please prepare separately and serve my dish separately.

text: 喺整好嘅菜度挑走致敏食物係唔安全嘅，請重新整過。
back_translation: Picking the allergen food out of an already-made dish is not safe; please make it again from scratch.

text: 我唔可以食自助餐，因為大家共用夾菜嘅匙羹同夾。
back_translation: I cannot eat at a buffet, because everyone shares the serving spoons and tongs.

text: 麵包舖通常對我唔安全，因為空氣同枱面都會有麵粉同果仁。
back_translation: Bakeries are usually not safe for me, because the air and countertops will have flour and nuts.

text: 呢道菜有冇我敏感嘅食物？
back_translation: Does this dish have the food I am allergic to?

text: 可唔可以幫我同廚師確認下材料？
back_translation: Can you help me confirm the ingredients with the chef?

text: 我可唔可以睇下材料嘅標籤或者包裝？
back_translation: Can I look at the ingredients label or packaging?

text: 呢個係咪同其他食物用同一鑊油炸？
back_translation: Is this fried in the same wok/batch of oil as other foods?

text: 呢個係咪同其他食物用同一個鑊或者煎鍋煮？
back_translation: Is this cooked in the same wok or frying pan as other foods?

text: 個醬汁有啲咩材料？
back_translation: What ingredients are in the sauce?

text: 啲肉或者魚有冇醃過？用咗咩醃？
back_translation: Has the meat or fish been marinated? Marinated with what?

text: 個沙律醬有啲咩材料？
back_translation: What ingredients are in the salad dressing?

text: 啲甜品有冇果仁、奶或者蛋？
back_translation: Do the desserts have nuts, milk or egg?

text: 啲麵包有冇奶、蛋、果仁或者籽？
back_translation: Does the bread have milk, egg, nuts or seeds?

text: 個湯用咩湯底？
back_translation: What soup base / stock is the soup made with?

text: 呢個係廚房自己整，定係買現成嘅？
back_translation: Is this made by the kitchen itself, or bought ready-made?

text: 有邊幾道菜你哋可以安全咁幫我整？
back_translation: Which dishes can you safely make for me?

text: 呢道菜可唔可以唔落我敏感嘅食物，重新整過？
back_translation: Can this dish be remade without putting in the food I am allergic to?

text: 廚師有冇信心呢道菜對我係安全？
back_translation: Is the chef confident that this dish is safe for me?

text: 有冇材料嘅標籤寫住「可能含有」我敏感嘅食物？
back_translation: Do any ingredient labels say 'may contain' the food I am allergic to?

text: 廚房有冇用果仁或者花生？
back_translation: Does the kitchen use nuts or peanuts?

text: 啲炸嘢係咪用共用嘅油炸？
back_translation: Are the fried foods fried in shared oil?

text: 係
back_translation: Yes / it is

text: 唔係
back_translation: No / it is not

text: 我唔肯定
back_translation: I'm not sure

text: 我去問下廚師
back_translation: I'll go ask the chef

text: 係，我哋可以安全咁整
back_translation: Yes, we can make it safely

text: 唔得，我哋冇辦法安全咁整
back_translation: No (can't), we have no way to make it safely

text: 入面有你敏感嘅食物
back_translation: It contains the food you are allergic to

text: 可能含有微量
back_translation: May contain traces

text: 我攞標籤俾你睇
back_translation: I'll get the label to show you

text: 我推介呢道菜
back_translation: I recommend this dish

text: 請㩒你嘅答案。
back_translation: Please press / tap your answer.

text: 可唔可以推介一道對我安全嘅菜？
back_translation: Can you recommend a dish that is safe for me?

text: 簡單啲就得，例如淨烤肉或者魚，配飯或者菜。
back_translation: Something simple is fine, for example plain grilled/roasted meat or fish, with rice or vegetables.

text: 請唔好落醬汁。
back_translation: Please don't add sauce.

text: 請淨係用鹽、胡椒同橄欖油煮。
back_translation: Please cook using only salt, pepper and olive oil.

text: 可唔可以幫我寫低啲材料？
back_translation: Can you write down the ingredients for me?

text: 如果你唔肯定，請話俾我知。我寧願唔叫，都唔想冒險。
back_translation: If you are not sure, please tell me. I would rather not order than take a risk.

text: 請確保送嚟俾我嘅係呢一道菜。
back_translation: Please make sure the dish delivered to me is this dish.

text: 上菜嘅時候，請確認呢個係無致敏食物嘅嗰道菜。
back_translation: When serving, please confirm this is the allergen-free dish.

text: 我淨係要杯嘢飲，唔該。
back_translation: I only want a drink, thank you.

text: 我可唔可以睇下致敏原資料或者致敏原餐牌？
back_translation: Can I look at the allergen information or an allergen menu?

text: 我食自己帶嚟嘅食物得唔得？
back_translation: Is it OK if I eat food I brought myself?

text: 多謝你幫手。
back_translation: Thank you for your help.

text: 我而家有敏感反應。
back_translation: I am having an allergic reaction right now.

text: 請即刻幫我叫白車。
back_translation: Please call an ambulance for me immediately.

text: 同佢哋講：過敏性休克，係嚴重嘅敏感反應。
back_translation: Tell them: anaphylactic shock, it is a severe allergic reaction.

text: 我個袋入面有腎上腺素自動注射筆。
back_translation: There is an adrenaline auto-injector pen in my bag.

text: 請幫我打針。
back_translation: Please help me give the injection.

text: 針要打喺大髀外側，可以隔住衫褲打。
back_translation: The injection should be given into the outer side of the thigh; it can be given through clothes/trousers.

text: 請幫我瞓低。唔好叫我企起身或者行。
back_translation: Please help me lie down. Don't make me stand up or walk.

text: 如果我好難呼吸，請扶我坐起身。
back_translation: If I have great difficulty breathing, please help me sit up.

text: 如果五分鐘後冇好轉，可以用第二支自動注射筆。
back_translation: If there is no improvement after five minutes, a second auto-injector pen can be used.

text: 請陪住我，等到救援人員嚟到。
back_translation: Please stay with me until the rescue personnel arrive.

text: 最近有急症室嘅醫院喺邊度？
back_translation: Where is the nearest hospital with an emergency room?

text: 最近嘅藥房喺邊度？
back_translation: Where is the nearest pharmacy?

text: 你有冇抗組織胺藥？
back_translation: Do you have antihistamine medicine?

text: 請幫我打俾我嘅緊急聯絡人。
back_translation: Please call my emergency contact for me.

text: 呢件產品有冇我敏感嘅食物？
back_translation: Does this product have the food I am allergic to?

text: 可唔可以幫我睇下呢個標籤？
back_translation: Can you help me read this label?

text: 標籤有冇寫可能含有微量？
back_translation: Does the label say 'may contain traces'?

text: 有冇冇我敏感食物嘅牌子？
back_translation: Is there a brand that doesn't have the food I am allergic to?

text: 你哋有冇賣無致敏原食品？
back_translation: Do you sell allergen-free foods?

text: 你哋有冇賣無麩質麵包或者意粉？
back_translation: Do you sell gluten-free bread or pasta?

text: 你哋有冇賣唔含果仁同黃豆嘅植物奶？
back_translation: Do you sell plant milk that does not contain nuts and soybean?

text: 請話俾早餐嘅員工知我有食物敏感。
back_translation: Please tell the breakfast staff that I have a food allergy.

text: 廚房可唔可以幫我整一份安全嘅餐？
back_translation: Can the kitchen make a safe meal for me?

text: 我有嚴重食物敏感。請唔好俾我任何我未確認過嘅飛機餐。
back_translation: I have a serious food allergy. Please do not give me any in-flight meal that I have not confirmed.

text: 可唔可以請附近嘅乘客唔好食果仁或者花生？
back_translation: Can you ask nearby passengers not to eat nuts or peanuts?

text: 我要隨時帶住我嘅敏感藥物。
back_translation: I need to carry my allergy medication with me at all times.

text: 我有醫生信證明我嘅藥物。
back_translation: I have a doctor's letter certifying my medication.
